item.title: [LU-20309] parallel-scale test_write_disjoint: timeout occurred
item.description:
This issue was created by maloo for jianyu <yujian@whamcloud.com>

This issue relates to the following test suite run: https://testing.whamcloud.com/test_sets/76e361ce-50d1-46c3-a1be-077245547a0f

test_write_disjoint failed with the following error:

Timeout occurred after 545 minutes, last suite running was parallel-scale

Test session details:
clients: https://build.whamcloud.com/job/lustre-master/4723 - 6.4.0-150700.53.34-default
servers: https://build.whamcloud.com/job/lustre-master/4723 - 5.14.0-611.47.1_lustre.el9.x86_64

<<Please provide additional information about the failure here>>

VVVVVVV DO NOT REMOVE LINES BELOW, Added by Maloo for auto-association VVVVVVV
parallel-scale test_write_disjoint - Timeout occurred after 545 minutes, last suite running was parallel-scale

status.description: The issue is open and ready for the assignee to start work on it.

comments.comment: Occurred 22 times on SLES 15 SP7 client in the past 2 weeks.

Similar to EX-7748 and identical to EX-14075.

Maloo search showes this failure only happens on SLES 15 SP7.

Testlog showes this failure has a high rate comes from MPI. Every user process is blocked in MPI Barrier, and then Lnet cannot find eth0. Although there is no direct envidence to show the connection, these two errors may be causally related.

Removing the 2.18 fix version as part of 2.18 release preparation: in the hung session examined, all ranks are waiting in an MPI collective with no Lustre activity, so this looks like an MPI hang rather than a Lustre one. Fix version can be set when this is picked up.

Triage of LU-20309 on master 834440df45 (no fix uploaded).

Rainshadow: 176 failures since 2026-05-07, all on SLES 15.7 clients (master, master-next, b2_15, b2_16; ldiskfs and zfs servers; el8/el9/el10 servers). No other client distro fails this way.

Hung session d6461e57 (2026-11-25, build 4775): the suite log ends at the mpirun line (np 8, btl tcp,self, UCX_NET_DEVICES=eth0). The client stack dump shows the write_disjoint ranks and mpirun sleeping in epoll_wait/poll, with no thread in the Lustre I/O path and no ldlm or RPC activity. That matches the earlier observation that the ranks are stuck in an MPI collective.

Timings: the test normally takes about 450 s (p50) but 10-15% of runs take about 2350 s and about 2% hang until the session timeout (about 18300 s). That is consistent with an MPI/UCX/TCP transport problem on the SLES 15 SP7 openmpi4 stack rather than a Lustre client problem.

Not reproduced: ltvm has no SLES target (rocky8/9/10 and ubuntu2404 only), so the SLES MPI stack could not be tried. That is not proof the problem is outside Lustre. Leaving it open. Next steps need SLES 15 SP7 nodes: run write_disjoint under mpirun with btl_base_verbose and a hang timeout, and check the openmpi/UCX versions. If it is confirmed as MPI, the likely fix is a test-framework change (skip or timeout on SLES 15.7), which needs a person to decide.
